message.content: The most valuable player (MVP) award for the most recent completed NBA season (2022‑2023) went to **Nikola Jokić** of the Denver Nuggets. He earned his second straight MVP trophy after leading the Nuggets to a 122‑107 win over the Los Angeles Lakers in the NBA Finals and finishing the regular season with a league‑best 30.4 points per game, 13.8 rebounds, and 9.9 assists.
